title: World Athletics Label Road Races results — Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris, 7 April 2024
claims: World Athletics records the Paris marathon in Paris (FRA) on 7 April 2024 under event ID 7208360; this was the 47th edition.
Women's winner: Mestawut FIKIR (ETH) 2:20:45; runner-up Enatnesh Alamrew TIRUSEW (ETH) 2:20:48.
The 2024 men's podium was completed by Titus Kipruto (KEN) 2:05:48 and Elisha Rotich (KEN) 2:06:54, per race recaps cross-checked against the WA listing.
